title: Hinter der Grinde
desc: Half an hour with nobody knowing where you are from
setting: A pub on Schmutziger Donnerstag at nine in the evening, twenty-five yellow costumes, and a mask you can barely see out of.

options.es: In der da hinten. Die Gelben.
options.en: That one back there. The yellow ones.
options.feedback: Point and answer. Behind a mask nobody is asking anything else, and that is the whole point.

options.es: Ich bin erst seit einem Jahr dabei.
options.en: I have only been in it for a year.
options.feedback: Nobody asked. It is the sentence you have been saying for three years and tonight you do not need it.
He could not tell. You just told him, and that is the one thing the mask was doing for you.

options.es: Trommel. Auf zwei und auf vier.
options.en: Drum. On two and on four.
options.feedback: The joke every single person in this room knows, told flat. He will laugh.
Say it once and then stop. Twice is asking somebody to argue with you.

options.es: Ich habe als Kind Klavier gelernt.
options.en: I learnt the piano as a child.
options.feedback: A CV where a one-word answer goes. It is loud in here and he has a beer.

steps.speaker: Jemand in der Beiz
steps.es: Kennst du den Erwin? Der spielt bei euch.
steps.en: Do you know Erwin? He plays with you.

options.es: Klar. Der mit der grossen Trompete.
options.en: Sure. The one with the big trumpet.
options.feedback: Yes, and one detail. That is how a stranger finds out you actually belong there.

options.en: No, I do not know him.
options.feedback: Twenty-five people and you have been going a year. He will believe you and wonder.

options.en: I do not know everybody yet.
options.feedback: Honest and it is the third sentence tonight that puts you outside the group.

steps.speaker: Jemand in der Beiz
steps.es: Nimmst du die Grinde nicht ab? Es ist heiss hier.
steps.en: Are you not taking the mask off? It is hot in here.

options.feedback: Taking it off in a conversation makes the conversation serious. Everybody here knows that rule.
Fine. Also the end of the half hour where nobody could hear where you are from.

options.es: Ich sehe damit fast nichts, aber es ist besser so.
options.en: I can hardly see with it, but it is better this way.
options.feedback: True, and it explains something that works better unexplained.
